standards.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.6.1.a: State a claim and arrange its reasons and evidence clearly.
standards.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.6.1.b: Support the claim with relevant evidence and clear reasoning from credible sources, showing topic understanding.
standards.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.6.1.c: Connect claims and reasons with suitable words, phrases and clauses.
standards.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.6.1.e: End with a conclusion that follows the argument.
standards.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.6.1: Use grade-appropriate grammar, including correct and consistent pronouns.
standards.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.6.2: Apply capitalization, punctuation and spelling conventions, including punctuation for parenthetical elements.
standards.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.6.3: Choose varied sentence patterns and maintain consistent style and tone.
